items.coder_A: other (tumour neoantigens confirmed for vaccine manufacture), eligibility, candidate_matched false
items.reason: "After confirmation of tumor neoantigens and eligibility, patients will be randomized" describes a manufacturing step for the personalised DC vaccine. The inclusion criterion asks only for tissue availability ("sufficient tumor tissue and blood samples for neoantigen identification"), not a molecular marker that defines the population. The trial has no candidate either way.

note: Excluded at S6 (dendritic cell vaccine plus temozolomide backbone), so the neoantigen row does not affect any analysed outcome. IDH-wildtype is diagnostic only. No D31 convention changes the coding (C1: excluded_intervention_type for the DC vaccine).
